cards.ex_en: Please do not omit any names from the list.
cards.ex_cn: 请不要从名单里漏掉任何名字。

cards.ex_en: The doctor called her recovery miraculous.
cards.ex_cn: 医生说她的康复堪称奇迹。

cards.ex_en: She was contriving a way to open the locked door.
cards.ex_cn: 她正想方设法打开那扇锁着的门。

cards.ex_en: The loud noise diverted the baby's attention.
cards.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音转移了婴儿的注意力。

cards.ex_en: Snow is uncommon in this warm city.
cards.ex_cn: 在这座温暖的城市里下雪很少见。

cards.ex_en: The boy kneeled down to tie his shoe.
cards.ex_cn: 男孩跪下来系鞋带。

cards.ex_en: This is fruitful land for growing rice.
cards.ex_cn: 这是一片适合种稻的沃土。

cards.ex_en: They built a fence to enclose the garden.
cards.ex_cn: 他们筑起篱笆把花园围起来。

cards.ex_en: Today is my parents' wedding anniversary.
cards.ex_cn: 今天是我父母的结婚纪念日。

cards.ex_en: We stayed in a small lodge in the mountains.
cards.ex_cn: 我们住在山里的一间小屋里。

cards.ex_en: She prepared the food beforehand.
cards.ex_cn: 她事先把食物准备好了。

cards.ex_en: People have different dispositions.
cards.ex_cn: 人各有不同的性情。

cards.ex_en: The sky was hazy in the early morning.
cards.ex_cn: 清晨的天空雾蒙蒙的。

cards.ex_en: A true friend will never forsake you.
cards.ex_cn: 真正的朋友永远不会抛弃你。

cards.ex_en: He trusted in the providences of heaven.
cards.ex_cn: 他相信上天的安排。

cards.ex_en: The workers dug a deep pit in the ground.
cards.ex_cn: 工人们在地上挖了一个深坑。

cards.ex_en: She drank tea from an earthenware cup.
cards.ex_cn: 她用一个陶杯喝茶。

cards.ex_en: The embers of the fire still glowed at night.
cards.ex_cn: 火堆的余烬夜里仍在发光。

cards.ex_en: They launched the new boat into the sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把新船放入海中。

cards.ex_en: The ship stayed at the dock all night.
cards.ex_cn: 船整夜停在码头。

cards.ex_en: She took a deep breath to compose herself.
cards.ex_cn: 她深吸一口气让自己镇定下来。

cards.ex_en: He lived a quiet and sedate life.
cards.ex_cn: 他过着安静沉稳的生活。

cards.ex_en: The farm had several enclosures for the sheep.
cards.ex_cn: 农场里有几处圈羊的围场。

cards.ex_en: The village has only a few inhabitants.
cards.ex_cn: 这个村子只有几户居民。

cards.ex_en: He tried to shun the crowded streets.
cards.ex_cn: 他尽量避开拥挤的街道。

cards.ex_en: The judge condemned the thief.
cards.ex_cn: 法官给那个小偷定了罪。

cards.ex_en: They prayed for the salvation of their souls.
cards.ex_cn: 他们为灵魂的救赎祈祷。

cards.ex_en: He was confounded by the strange sight.
cards.ex_cn: 那奇怪的景象让他惊愕不已。

cards.ex_en: The heat in the desert was hellish.
cards.ex_cn: 沙漠里的酷热如同地狱。

cards.ex_en: Be cautious when you cross the road.
cards.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。

cards.ex_en: In his haste, he forgot his keys.
cards.ex_cn: 他匆忙之中忘了带钥匙。

cards.ex_en: She used a paddle to move the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 她用桨划动小船。

cards.ex_en: The old man drank a glass of brandy.
cards.ex_cn: 老人喝了一杯白兰地。

cards.ex_en: Safety is our foremost concern.
cards.ex_cn: 安全是我们最重要的考虑。

cards.ex_en: The sailors feared meeting a cannibal on the island.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们害怕在岛上遇到食人者。

cards.ex_en: The witnesses gave their testimonies in court.
cards.ex_cn: 证人在法庭上作了证词。

cards.ex_en: She thanked them with great sincerity.
cards.ex_cn: 她十分真诚地感谢了他们。

cards.ex_en: A kind benefactor paid for his school.
cards.ex_cn: 一位好心的恩人替他付了学费。

cards.ex_en: The monks lived in an old monastery.
cards.ex_cn: 修士们住在一座古老的修道院里。

cards.ex_en: The lieutenant led his men bravely.
cards.ex_cn: 中尉勇敢地率领他的部下。

cards.ex_en: He ignored all her entreaties to stay.
cards.ex_cn: 他不理会她留下来的一再恳求。

cards.ex_en: They feared that danger might befall them.
cards.ex_cn: 他们担心危险会降临到自己身上。

cards.ex_en: Illness confined him to his bed.
cards.ex_cn: 疾病使他卧床不起。
